info.name: pet-shop-management-system-midterm
info.description: Pet Shop Management System, mid-term INSY 8322. One request per requirement, named by its ID. Student: David Ndjimbo, ID 25965.

request.description: A1 entities and relationships. 200: every groomer shows its groomingBay and its petTypes, and the pet types do not show their groomers (no JSON loop).
A2 CRUD (get by id). 200 with the pet owner. With an unknown id: 404 The pet owner with that id does not exist. Change the method and path for save, all, update or delete.
B1 derived query. 200: pet owners with last name Ndjimbo, letter case ignored, sorted by firstName A to Z. Empty list when nobody matches.
B2 derived query. 200: sessions in that status, earliest sessionDate first. Invalid status gives 400.
B3 derived query. 200: sessions between the two dates, both inclusive, ordered by sessionDate.
C1 JPQL join on the petTypes collection with LOWER. 200: groomers that hold Dogs (Alice and Grace).
C2 JPQL NOT EXISTS. 200: grooming bays that no groomer occupies, sorted by bayNumber (bay 4 with the seed data).
C3 JPQL IS EMPTY. 200: pet types nobody holds (Rabbits with the seed data).
C4 JPQL DISTINCT with path navigation. 200: pet owners of Alice, each listed once. Unknown groomer id: 404 The groomer with that id does not exist.

D1 safe saving. First run: 201 Grooming session saved successfully, saved as BOOKED. Second run: 409 Groomer is already booked on that date. A past sessionDate gives 400 Grooming session date cannot be in the past. Delete the test session afterwards.
D2 status flow. BOOKED to IN_PROGRESS: 200 Grooming session status updated successfully. Then status=BOOKED gives 400 Cannot change status from IN_PROGRESS to BOOKED. Unknown id: 404.
D3 add one pet type to a groomer. First run: 200 Pet type added to the groomer (the old pet types are kept). Second run: 409 The groomer already has that pet type. Unknown ids: 404.

D4 move a groomer to another grooming bay. 200 Grooming bay changed successfully (check the old bay with C2). bayNumber=3 gives 409 That grooming bay is taken by another groomer. bayNumber=99 gives 404.

E1 write a product sale. 201 Product sale saved successfully (soldDate is today). A grooming session that is not FINISHED gives 400 Product sales are only for FINISHED grooming sessions. Unknown session: 404.
E2 JPQL product sale history of a pet owner, newest soldDate first. Empty list when there is none.

E3 delete and protect. This session has product sales: 409 That grooming session has product sales, delete them first. For the product sale delete use DELETE /api/product-sales/delete/{id}: 200 Product sale deleted successfully, unknown id 404.
F1 JPQL GROUP BY and COUNT. 200: one row per status with its count, a status with zero sessions does not appear.
F2 JPQL bulk UPDATE. 200 with the real number, for example 1 grooming sessions cancelled. FINISHED sessions are not touched.
Bonus dashboard. 200: one JSON object with petOwners, groomers, freeBays, sessionsToday, booked and productSales.
Bonus pagination. 200: a Page of grooming sessions with totalPages and totalElements.
